_purpose: The first five minutes: the short guided tour a new person meets, the same steps on the desktop app (src/gui/first_minutes.rs) and the website (web/shared/onboarding-tour.js). Each step's title and text are KEYS in data/i18n/ (translated like every other word; the text may carry [[glossary]] marks). web.page / web.target: where the website's 'Take me there' goes and which element its ring points at. native.page: the desktop page id (gui/dispatch.rs page_id), native.settings: a Settings section. done_when: a fact the app can see that ticks the step by itself (phrase_written, message_sent, entered_world); without it the person moves on with Next. Edit here: no code change needed to add, remove or reorder a step.
